title: Tofu Indian Kebabs
description: A spicy and nutty twist on traditional Indian kebabs, featuring marinated tofu and a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: Extra-firm, drained and cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredients.name: Spicy Indian Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most grocery stores or online

ingredients.name: Garam masala
ingredients.notes: Ground spice blend commonly used in Indian cuisine

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.notes: Ground, adds citrusy, slightly sweet flavor

ingredients.name: Cayenne pepper
ingredients.notes: Add more or less to taste

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed, adds brightness and acidity

ingredients.name: Nutty Peanut oil
ingredients.notes: Substitute with neutral oil if necessary

instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine Spice Blend, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, and salt. Blend until smooth.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice and blended spice mixture.
3. Add tofu cubes to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
4. Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
5. Thread marinated tofu onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Brush grill or grill pan with Peanut oil to prevent sticking.
7. Grill tofu kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy on the outside.
8. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
